summary: Iteration 8 verified gallery tab UI on /il-club, media reseed, footer regression, contatti + admin dashboard. All backend endpoints and all frontend acceptance criteria pass. Only note: admin gallery-group editors use indexed testids (gallery-group-editor-0/1/2), not the exact string 'gallery-group-editor' mentioned in the request — this matches the code and is a spec-vs-implementation naming nuance, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Request references data-testid='gallery-group-editor' (singular). Actual implementation uses indexed 'gallery-group-editor-{i}'. Consider adding a wrapper testid='gallery-group-editor' on the container for spec alignment, or update the acceptance criteria/docs.
Public pages emit ~4 console 401 errors (auth/me probe). Non-blocking but noisy — consider suppressing errors for the anonymous /api/auth/me call.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing reseeded media (9 eventi, 3 location, 2 dettagli).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery tab UI at /il-club is fully functional. Backend GET /api/media?category=gallery-eventi returns 9 items, gallery-location 3, gallery-dettagli 2. Settings.about_gallery_groups has 3 entries (eventi-pubblico, location, dettagli). Layout footer paragraph 'Il club all'aperto sulla costa tirrenica calabrese' is confirmed removed (grep found no matches in src). Admin login route is /admin/login (email+password form, testid=admin-login-btn). Admin gallery editors use indexed testids gallery-group-editor-0..2; contact-editor testid exists as-is.
